target_objection: DR collapses into North-style objective perspicuity or generic representation justification.

construction.systems: Two learning systems have distinct internal update mechanisms but generate the same minimal state sufficient for predicting the next behavioral response.
construction.representation: R_pred compresses each system to the minimal predictive state.
construction.granted_scientific_superiority: R_pred may be objectively superior for the predictive target because it exposes the predictive dependency directly and omits details irrelevant to that target.
construction.missing_identity_warrant: Capacity identity may depend on the suppressed update mechanism, so the predictive invariant alone does not establish sameness of capacity.

logical_point: scientific warrant or even target-specific superiority of R_pred is granted
individuative warrant for one invariant exposed by R_pred does not follow
a North-style perspicuity argument aimed at the identity-relevant target itself can discharge DR
perspicuity for a different genuine target does not automatically transfer to capacity identity
non_circular_failure_condition: DR fails when the only support for the identity relevance of I is the same representation-level success that licensed R, while a live source-compatible preservation choice leaves an identity-relevant distinction unresolved.
claim_scope: Conceptual counterexample only; no new empirical result.
